def build_agent(sandbox):

    CENTER_X = 6.0

    base = sandbox.add_beam(x=CENTER_X, y=GLASS_Y, width=0.05, height=0.05, angle=0, density=0.01)
    sandbox.weld_to_glass(base, (CENTER_X, GLASS_Y))
    
    # Create six thin beams to cover the full 12m glass length

    # Pivot joint at the center to enable sweeping motion
    pivot = sandbox.add_joint(
        base, bars[2], (CENTER_X, GLASS_Y + 0.05),

    )
    return {"body": base, "motors": [pivot]}
